run_train_detector: run the training script with a config file to train a 3D object detector
run_train_with_resume: run the training script resuming from a saved checkpoint file
run_train_distributed: run the training script with pytorch distributed launcher across multiple GPUs
run_train_no_validate: run the training script without validation during training to save time
run_train_autoscale_lr: run the training script with automatic learning rate scaling based on GPU count
